scripts.build:frontend-deps: bun run --bun --filter i18n build && bun run --bun --filter icons-subsetter build && bun run --bun --filter misskey-js build
scripts.build:backend-deps: bun run --bun --filter i18n build && bun run --bun --filter misskey-js build
scripts.build: bun run build-pre && bun run --bun --filter '*' --if-present build && bun run build-assets
scripts.build-storybook: bun run build:frontend-deps && bun run --bun --filter frontend build-storybook
scripts.build-misskey-js-with-types: bun run build-pre && bun run build:backend-deps && bun run --bun --filter backend build && bun run --bun --filter backend generate-api-json --no-build && cp packages/backend/built/api.json packages/misskey-js/generator/api.json && bun run --bun --filter misskey-js update-autogen-code && bun run --bun --filter misskey-js build && bun run --bun --filter misskey-js api
scripts.start: cd packages/backend && bun run compile-config && bun ./built/entry.js
scripts.start:inspect: cd packages/backend && bun run compile-config && bun --inspect ./built/entry.js
scripts.start:test: cp ./.github/misskey/test.yml ./.config/test.yml && cd packages/backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=test bun run compile-config && cross-env NODE_ENV=test bun ./built/entry.js
scripts.migrateandstart: bun run migrate && bun run start
scripts.lint: bun run lint:ox && bun run typecheck:playwright && bun run --bun --filter '*' --if-present typecheck
scripts.start:test:dev-container: cp ./.config/playwright-devcontainer.yml ./.config/test.yml && cd packages/backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=test bun run compile-config && cross-env NODE_ENV=test bun ./built/entry.js
scripts.e2e-dev-container: MISSKEY_TEST_START_COMMAND='bun run start:test:dev-container' bun run pw:run
